additionalComplexBounds.analyticJustification: For z=x+iv in the tube, Re(1+z^2)=1+x^2-v^2>1-r^2. Principal Log is holomorphic there. These y-independent majorants are integrable against finite mu, so the holomorphic integral and differentiation under the integral are valid.
